svg.title: ARCHIMED light pipeline overview
svg.desc: One ARCHIMED light step: input files and tables, directional sky, projection onto the plot, ordered pixel stacks, first-order interception, optional multiple scattering, and output CSV tables.
svg.text: From inputs to outputs, ARCHIMED uses six steps to compute light interception.

g.text: Projected triangle area is compared with touched-pixel area.
Only the top hit contributes visible area.
Visible area x directional flux gives Ri_0.
The same ordered stack is reused.
